editorial.intro: Freightliner truck clipart features highway tractors, work trucks and heavy hauling scenes. Long sleeper cabs, square cabovers and construction bodies appear beside machinery, timber loads and industrial equipment. The drawings include recognizable truck families alongside close views of badges and cab details.
paragraphs: Freightliner truck clipart features highway tractors, work trucks and heavy hauling scenes. Long sleeper cabs, square cabovers and construction bodies appear beside machinery, timber loads and industrial equipment. The drawings include recognizable truck families alongside close views of badges and cab details.

Browse {{artworkCount}} illustrations in color and black and white, from a crane truck with deployed outriggers to loaded flatbeds and logging trucks. editorial.intro: Levi's clipart focuses on denim clothing, casual outfits and familiar brand details. The collection includes jeans, denim jackets and coordinated looks, with attention to pockets, seams, rolled hems and contrasting washes. Individual garments sit alongside complete illustrated outfits.
